claims.claim: Core Scientific's transition from bitcoin mining toward AI/HDC infrastructure has accelerated: its AMD partnership has potential for up to 2.5 GW, anchored by about 530 MW under 15-year agreements and more than $14B of potential base contracted revenue.

risks.risk: Large prospective capacity and contracted-revenue figures require substantial capital deployment and successful site delivery.

unknowns.unknown: Economics of the full prospective 2.5 GW beyond the anchored 530 MW are not yet contracted or proven.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 colocation revenue rose to $136.7M from $77.5M in Q1; billing capacity rose to 395 MW in Q2 and 437 MW by mid-July, while total leased customer power reached about 1.1 GW.

risks.risk: Q2 CapEx was $797.5M and GAAP net loss was $1.16B, although the loss was primarily driven by warrant fair-value changes; execution is capital intensive.

contradictions.contradiction: Rapid colocation revenue and capacity growth coexist with very high capital intensity and a large GAAP net loss.

unknowns.unknown: Future financing cost, customer concentration, build timing and stabilized return on invested capital remain unverified.
